# Per-repository advisory locking for serialization

Serialization of operations per repository instance is enforced using PostgreSQL advisory locks, keyed on the repository slug. This prevents concurrent conflicting operations on the same repository and supports pre-row creation locking.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/db.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.db.repo_lock_key`
